request: Analyze GSE178262 for PMID 34142717 (Transcriptomic, proteomic and phosphoproteomic underpinnings of daily exercise performance and zeitgeber activity of training in mouse muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends. [review calibration: seeded case]

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, kallisto + tximport lengthScaledTPM pseudo-counts (S2.8.p2)
final.inclusion: this case: the 16 scheduled-wheel samples (CTRL and DA at ZT4 and ZT16, n=4 each)
final.primary_estimand: effect of the timing of 3 weeks of voluntary wheel training (daytime wheel access with dark-phase food restriction, DA, vs ad-libitum night-time wheel access, CTRL) on gastrocnemius gene expression at ZT4 and at ZT16
planned_contrasts: DA vs CTRL at ZT4 (S3.8.p1; Fig. 12A; paper: 2094 DEGs)
DA vs CTRL at ZT16 (S3.8.p1; Fig. 12A; paper: 368 DEGs)
final.paper_results: 2094 DEGs at ZT4, 368 at ZT16 (S3.8.p1); overlap includes Klf4, Klf5, Klf15, Maf factors, Nr4a3; Atf3, Per2, Ppargc1a and Ppara induced only by daytime training

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 defines CTRL and DA; it states that only daytime vs night-time wheel-active animals are compared, not trained vs sedentary. S3.8.p1 reports 2094 DEGs at ZT4 and 368 at ZT16. The paper states FDR <= 0.05 for the RNA-seq DEGs (S3.3.p2) and gives no other rule for this experiment.

checks: GEO titles CTRL/DA ZT4/ZT16 with n=4 match S2.3/S3.8

ownership.reasoning: Same series and submitter as the treadmill case.

alignment.reasoning: Lane-summed matrix with GSM columns (see treadmill case); exact alignment on the metadata index. act from the treatment-group field (Night activity = CTRL, Day activity = DA, matching GEO titles CTRL/DA); zt from the zeitgeber-time field.

matrix.matrix_type: estimated counts (tximport lengthScaledTPM gene-level pseudo-counts from kallisto)
matrix.reasoning: Same matrix as the treadmill case: non-integer count-scale pseudo-counts; S2.8.p2 analyses them with DESeq2.

final.analysis_type: factorial 2x2 (act x zt), cell-means model, simple effects of act within zt
final.exploratory: ZT16 vs ZT4 within each group and the act x zt interaction

design.reasoning: Two training-timing groups within each sampling time; DA is the reference arm.

candidates.reason_rejected: the paper reports each ZT separately; time of day changes expression strongly

covariance.reasoning: Independent single-housed mice, one sample each; same sequencing run; all male.

final.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald, joint cell-means model on the 16 wheel samples)

paper_route.reason: same method on the same pseudo-counts via pydeseq2; model scope not stated

deviations: one fit on all 16 wheel samples; unshrunk log2FC

threshold.reasoning: S3.3.p2 defines RNA-seq DEGs as FDR <= 0.05; no fold-change rule is stated for the wheel experiment either.

caveats: both arms exercise: the estimand is the timing of training (plus the DA feeding restriction), not exercise vs sedentary
feeding schedule differs between arms by design
